description: Brand a connector project's hosted sign-in and consent pages: accent colour (buttons/links), background colour (hex like #2563eb; null resets to the DenkOps default) and/or an icon (PNG, JPEG or WebP as base64, max 2 MB). Omitted fields stay unchanged; text colour is chosen automatically for contrast. A `branding` block in denkops.json overrides these values on the next deploy. Workspace owners only; the connector must be enabled.
name: set_connector_branding
title: Set connector branding
